title: Question 3.1: Tokenizer - Setting Input and Output Columns
instruction: Computers need to break down text into smaller pieces to analyze it. This code sets up a tool to do that transformation.
reveal: A Tokenizer splits text into individual words (tokens). For example, "Great food!" becomes ["Great", "food"]. The `.setInputCol("text")` tells it to read from the "text" column, and `.setOutputCol("words")` tells it to put the result in a new column called "words". This is the first step in converting text into a format the computer can analyze.
